correctness.rationale: The finite-local Nakayama criterion ensures a generator tuple defines an automorphism iff each dth power vanishes and its linear matrix is invertible. If d=mp^s, m>1, a mixed term coefficient of a linear form raised to d is binomial(d,p^s) nonzero mod p, forcing monomial leading rows. The p^s-th powers lie in a complete-intersection subalgebra truncated at m; the coefficient of t^{m-1} in g^m is b times a unit, implying divisibility by the distinguished variable. This produces precisely d^r-1-m^{r-1} allowed higher coefficients per image; for m=1, Frobenius makes all nilpotents d-nilpotent. Exponent counting gives both orders and geometric reduced charts. The standalone verifier exhaustively reproduced five small cases and independently sampled four larger cases; finite tests are not universal proof.
